# Stated facts that matter for the rules. Only the akita fact feeds a rule here.
FACTS = {

}

# Atoms the game state does not settle. Each is enumerated over both truth values.

OPEN_ATOMS = [

RULES = [
    ("R1", "seahorse_reveals", True,
     lambda w, d: w["seahorse_carries_apples_oranges"]),
    ("R2", "gorilla_creates", True,
     lambda w, d: not w["gorilla_surrenders_to_akita"]),
    ("R3", "gorilla_creates", False,
     lambda w, d: w["gorilla_under_22_5_months"]),
    ("R4", "seahorse_reveals", True,

    ("R6", "goose", False,

    ("R7", "gorilla_creates", False,
     lambda w, d: w["gorilla_carries_apples_oranges"]),
    ("R8", "seahorse_reveals", False,
     lambda w, d: w["stork_leaves_seahorse_house"]),
    ("R9", "goose", True,
     lambda w, d: w["someone_smiles_at_monkey"]),
]

# (winner, loser) pairs from the stated preferences
SUPERIORITY = {("R3", "R2"), ("R7", "R2"), ("R8", "R1"), ("R8", "R4"), ("R9", "R6")}

# Evaluation order follows the dependency chain: R6 needs the first two stages.
STAGES = ["gorilla_creates", "seahorse_reveals", "goose"]


def evaluate(world):
    """Return {predicate: True (proved), False (disproved), None (unknown)} for one world."""
    derived = {}
    for pred in STAGES:
        pos = [r for r in RULES if r[1] == pred and r[2] and r[3](world, derived)]
        neg = [r for r in RULES if r[1] == pred and not r[2] and r[3](world, derived)]
        pos_ok = bool(pos) and all(any((p[0], n[0]) in SUPERIORITY for p in pos) for n in neg)
        neg_ok = bool(neg) and all(any((n[0], p[0]) in SUPERIORITY for n in neg) for p in pos)
        if pos_ok and not neg_ok:
            derived[pred] = True
        elif neg_ok and not pos_ok:
            derived[pred] = False
        else:
            derived[pred] = None
    return derived


def outcomes(fixed=None):
    """Group every consistent world by the status of 'cobra creates castle for goose'."""
    groups = {}
    for vals in product([False, True], repeat=len(OPEN_ATOMS)):
        world = dict(FACTS)
        world.update(zip(OPEN_ATOMS, vals))
        if fixed and any(world[k] != v for k, v in fixed.items()):
            continue
        status = evaluate(world)["goose"]
        groups.setdefault(status, []).append(world)
    return groups


def verdict(groups):
    keys = set(groups)
    if keys == {True}:
        return "proved"
    if keys == {False}:
        return "disproved"
    return "unknown"


def witness(groups, key):
    w = groups[key][0]
    return {k: w[k] for k in OPEN_ATOMS}
